typeHints.http: Calls a URL and checks the status code, and a keyword if you set one.
typeHints.tcp: Checks that a port accepts connections.
typeHints.ping: Sends ping from the Termix server, or from a host you pick below.
typeHints.dns: Looks up a record and can check its value.
typeHints.tls: Checks that a certificate is trusted and not about to end.
typeHints.push: Gives you a URL to call from a cron job or script. Goes down when the calls stop.
typeHints.host: Checks a host's port the same way as the host status dot. Never logs in.
typeHints.docker: Logs in to the host over SSH and checks that a container is running and healthy.
typeHints.systemd: Logs in to the host over SSH and checks that a unit is active.
typeHints.command: Logs in to the host over SSH and runs a command. It is up when the exit code is 0.

editor.dnsServerHint: Optional IP address. Empty uses the server's own.
editor.expectedHint: Optional. Text one record must contain.
editor.commandHint: Runs as your login on that host each check.
